messages:
julia (AE): Quick ask — NorthStar wants a 6-week POC with a tiered discount: 30% off for the first 3 months, then 15% for the following 9 months. No upfront commit yet. Need deal-desk + finance ok and MOU/contract path. CC: @sam-deal-desk @anna-finance @mike-eng
sam (deal-desk): What's the expected spend during the POC? Need numbers to evaluate margin and approval band. Also, is this credit or a customer prepaid commit?
julia (AE): Ballpark: list price would be ~ $16k/mo => ~$48k across 3 months. Usage estimate ~100M tokens. Proposal: usage billed normally, apply a 30% credit for first 3 months. No upfront money.
anna (finance): If it's non-committal credits, discount bands are stricter. Finance needs margin calc — if it's credit, we need to treat as contra-revenue. Also need tax/legal signoff on credits. @oliver (legal)
sam (deal-desk): Deal desk can approve up to 25% for zero-commitment pilots. 30% needs Rev Dir signoff. Alternative: 25% + $10k pilot credit to get to equivalent economics. Avoids setting high precedent.
julia (AE): They're pushing hard for 30% — strategic logo in retail. They hinted they'll convert to Dedicated infra in ~9 months if perf OK. Could we offer 25% + $10k + a 60-day dedicated trial instead?
mike (eng): We can run a scoped POC: reserve 1x A100-equivalent for ~3 weeks, then autoscale. VPC peering + SSO will take ~2 weeks to set up. If we promise dedicated trial, ops lead time is 2–3 weeks. Need SOW.
oliver (legal): For credits it's cleaner to structure as a credit memo vs altering list price. Also want a capped usage clause. I'll draft an MOU/SOW template — can share by EOD tomorrow.
anna (finance): OK — if we do 25% + $10k credit + a hard cap (e.g., $40k for the 90d window) finance can accept. Need to know how we invoice/credit and accounting treatment.
sam (deal-desk): Noted. I'll escalate the 30% ask to @marcus (rev-dir). Marcus, can you weigh in on approving 30% for this POC? :point_down:
marcus (rev-dir): I can approve 30% on a conditional basis: require a signed MOU committing to attempt conversion to a Dedicated contract within 90 days and an ARR target of >= $300k in 12 months. Also CS must own onboarding and success metrics. If those conditions are met, I sign off.
julia (AE): Thanks — I'll push the conditions to the customer and ask them to sign an MOU. Can someone own drafting the MOU + SOW? @oliver
oliver (legal): I'll draft a short MOU + SOW and include conversion milestone language. Will post a draft here by EOD tomorrow.
mike (eng): Quick flag for infra: before we promise dedicated trial, I need to confirm capacity — will follow up with infra team. If capacity scarce, we might swap to a hosted performance SLA instead.
sam (deal-desk): For the record, conditional approval: 30% Q1 credit if MOU + conversion clause + ARR target + capped usage. I'll update deal desk ticket `D-2879`. :white_check_mark:
julia (AE): Awesome — I'll coordinate with customer and schedule POC kickoff once MOU signed. Leaving thread open for any blockers. :rocket:
